def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    M = int(next(it))
    tasks = []
    for _ in range(N):
        x = int(next(it))
        t = int(next(it))
        steps = []
        for _ in range(t):
            a = int(next(it))
            b = int(next(it))
            steps.append((a, b))
        tasks.append((x, steps))
    rental_costs = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(M)]
    purchase_costs = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(M)]

    # dp[i][mask] = max profit after processing first i tasks with mask of rented machines
    dp = [[-10**18] * (1 << M) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 0

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        x, steps = tasks[i - 1]
        for mask in range(1 << M):
            if dp[i - 1][mask] == -10**18:
                continue
            # Option 1: rent all machines for this task
            cost_rent = sum(rental_costs[m] for m in range(M) if (mask >> m) & 1)
            new_mask = mask
            profit = dp[i - 1][mask] + x - cost_rent
            if profit > dp[i][new_mask]:
                dp[i][new_mask] = profit
            # Option 2: purchase all machines for this task
            cost_purchase = sum(purchase_costs[m] for m in range(M) if (mask >> m) & 1)
            new_mask = mask
            profit = dp[i - 1][mask] + x - cost_purchase
            if profit > dp[i][new_mask]:
                dp[i][new_mask] = profit

    print(max(dp[N]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
